Grappled.name: Grappled
Grappled.description: Grappled creatures cannot make voluntary movements. A Grapple ends when either party is moved by Knockback.

Prone.name: Prone
Prone.description: Prone creatures must spend twice as much Speed to move and Melee attacks against them has Boon(1). A Prone creature can use the Move action to remove the condition if their speed is more than 0.

Blinded.name: Blinded
Blinded.description: Blind creatures can only see adjacent Spaces.

Exposed.name: Exposed
Exposed.description: Attacks against Exposed creatures gain Boon(1).

Slowed.name: Slowed
Slowed.description: Slowed creatures have their Speed reduced by N.
